test_PDDL_valid_sentences: test PDDL grammar recognition by validating valid sentences against EBNF grammars for blocks, depot, and satellite domains
test_PDDL_valid_prefixes: test PDDL prefix acceptance by checking that valid full sentences and prefixes are recognized as valid prefixes
test_PDDL_invalid_sentences: test PDDL grammar rejection by verifying invalid sentences with wrong operators, arguments, or types are rejected
review_PDDLTestCase_dataclass: review the PDDLTestCase dataclass that stores test case names and PDDL domain strings for grammar validation
